verdict.rationale: Ironclad's no-code contract builder, Workflow Designer, and API let legal-ops create and launch workflows for any contract type, and one HN commenter confirms using it for new-contractor onboarding paperwork. However, there is no specific evidence of built-in templates or workflows for confidentiality/IP agreements or option/equity grants — these would have to be custom-built, and no equity-paperwork use case is documented. Missing for 10: dedicated offer-letter/IP-agreement/option-grant templates, equity-specific workflow examples, and independent confirmation of use for equity/hiring paperwork beyond one anecdote.
